records.notes: No single system-wide average or median is directly stated for all 307 territories combined. notes: Item 19 presents 2023 gross revenue data for 307 franchised territories open continuously throughout 2022 and 2023 (open_24_plus_mo cohort), broken into quartiles by gross revenue. The four quartile records capture average and median per quartile plus top-10 and bottom-10 territory receipts. A fifth summary record captures the overall system min/max and quartile boundaries. No expense data is disclosed; franchisor explicitly states they cannot estimate break-even. Company-owned territories excluded. Figures not audited. System-wide Sylvan Edge gross revenues 2023: $993,984; ACE IT! Program gross revenues 2023: $5,632,957.
